items.title: Victor Moore Interview, 1976-03-17
items.q: George Rapp used to be in there every night dancing.

ctx.x: There was a band playing opposite you at the Cinderella, wasn't there?

Several. We outlasted three bands. Harold Oxley's band was one of them, and oh, the Dutchman Kruger, Willie Krieger, or something Krieger. These were all big bands. George Rapp used to be in there every night dancing. He was a terrific band. Charleston was born there at Cinderella when we were playing there.
There was a reference to Charleston in one of the books here. Right. And it says that at the time that Bix was leaving, Oakland had to live by Oakland
